pairs.subject: wizard-flows
pairs.evidence: src/app/playground/page.tsx:17 The playground holds one selection index that drives a scripted terminal replay, and the flow composer is a free-form canvas editor (nodes and wires, autosaved to the URL hash) with no ordered steps, no dependent questions and no final commit; a case-insensitive search of src/app/playground and src/components/flow-composer found no 'step' token at all, and the wizard identifiers below have no hits in src/components or src/app/playground, so the staged-commitment precondition of wizard-flows does not hold here.

techniques.evidence: src/components/flow-composer/use-flow-composer.ts:24 Composer state is a node/wire graph edited freely on one canvas. There is no step position, visited set or step registry to model.

src/components/flow-composer/use-flow-composer.ts:59 The canvas persists to the URL hash as a shareable document, not as a draft snapshot of a multi-step flow. Nothing has side effects, so no wizard resume tier applies.
src/components/flow-composer/index.tsx:176 The CTA is a marketing link that shows counts. There is no review step and no apply action that turns a draft into a real resource.
src/app/playground/PromptSelector.tsx:24 The prompt cards are a single, independent choice. There is no step sequence, so there is no position or remaining count to communicate.
